title: How to Actually Win a Limited Sneaker Drop
description: Raffles, release calendars, notifications and backup plans that help you cop limited sneakers at retail instead of paying double on resale.
excerpt: Sold out in 30 seconds again? That's not bad luck — most people just play the drop game wrong.
content:
A limited drop selling out before your cart even loads — we've all been there. The good news: most people play this badly, and a few habits put you ahead of the pack.

## Raffles beat fast fingers

Most hyped releases now run through raffles, not first-come-first-served. Enter all of them: Nike SNKRS, adidas Confirmed, plus your local retailers. More raffles = more tickets. Fill in your profile ahead of time — card and address included. When you win, you often get just minutes to check out.

## Follow release calendars

Don't rely on luck. Release calendars tell you what drops, when and where. Skim the week ahead every Sunday and set reminders. On SNKRS, turn on push notifications — drop times shift without warning.

## Have a plan B: retail vs resale

Missed it? Set a ceiling. Resale at 1.2–1.4× retail is normal for hyped pairs; above 2×, wait it out — hype fades within six months for most models and prices come down.

## Don't skip the basics

Most pairs are lost not to bots but to plain unpreparedness: missing address, expired card, ignored notification.
